mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. The relationship is continuous and active at all times.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for FEDFUNDS as a predictor of 20-day forward returns falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or the correlation between FEDFUNDS and 20-day returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 5.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which typically precedes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.0, or the average 20-day return in triggered periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate weakening consumer demand, which predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative returns in more than 40% of instances, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a supply shock regime, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals reduced economic output, which predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The mechanism fails to predict negative returns in more than 40% of supply shock periods, or the Rank IC for INDPRO in supply shock regimes is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained inflation rate above 3.0% (CPIAUCSL) signals monetary policy tightening expectations, which predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0, or the average 60-day return in triggered periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate is rising and the federal funds rate is low, it signals a weak labor market amid accommodative monetary policy, which predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
regime_hint: labor market weakness with low rates
failure_condition: The joint condition of rising UNRATE and low FEDFUNDS fails to predict negative returns in more than 40% of instances, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a housing market downturn regime, a decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1500 thousand units predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The mechanism fails to predict negative returns in more than 40% of housing market downturn periods, or the Rank IC for HOUST in housing downturn regimes is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A lower level of industrial production (INDPRO) predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, as it signals reduced economic activity and corporate earnings pressure.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for INDPRO as a predictor of 5-day forward returns falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or the correlation between INDPRO and 5-day returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).
